entries.name: container
entries.note: Pass the element as the first constructor argument. An id string must be looked up with document.getElementById first.

entries.name: library_path
entries.note: Nothing to host: TradeCanvas is an npm package bundled with your app. Drop it.

entries.name: debug
entries.note: No debug logging switch. Drop it.

entries.name: symbol
entries.note: Symbol names are whatever your feed understands; no exchange prefix is needed.

entries.name: timeframe
entries.note: No option: call one in onReady. Presets are 1D, 5D, 1M, 3M, 6M, YTD, 1Y, 5Y, All. A { from, to } range is in seconds; setVisibleRange takes ms.

entries.name: time_frames
entries.note: Near: the range bar has fixed presets (1D to All) and picks the interval itself. Your own list and resolutions cannot be set; rangeBar: false hides it.

entries.name: timezone
entries.note: IANA names and 'exchange' carry over as they are. Omit it for the browser's zone.

entries.name: locale
entries.note: Codes like zh_TW become 'zh-Hant'. Only 'en' and 'vi' are built in; call registerWidgetLocales() for the other 28.

entries.name: favorites
entries.note: drawingTools go to drawingFavorites (tool names differ: see the drawing table), intervals to defaultTimeframeFavorites. Chart type and indicator favorites have no equivalent.

entries.name: datafeed
entries.note: Rewrite it as a DataFeed (getBars, subscribeBars, resolveSymbol); see the datafeed table. Symbol search goes to the searchSymbols option.

entries.name: additional_symbol_info_fields
entries.note: The symbol info panel shows fixed fields from SymbolInfo; extra fields cannot be added.

entries.name: snapshot_url
entries.note: No upload endpoint. Take the image with screenshotBlob() and post it to your server yourself.

entries.name: width
entries.note: The widget fills its container: give the container element a width in CSS.

entries.name: height
entries.note: The widget fills its container: give the container element a height in CSS.

entries.name: fullscreen
entries.note: No start-in-fullscreen option: size the container to the window with CSS. widget.toggleFullscreen() uses the browser fullscreen.

entries.name: autosize
entries.note: Always on: the widget follows its container size. Drop it.

entries.name: toolbar_bg
entries.note: Toolbar colours come from the theme and the --tcw-* tokens; set them in a Theme object, not a single colour.

entries.name: custom_themes
entries.note: Give a Theme object to theme. Colour ramps do not carry over: map the colours you used by hand.

entries.name: custom_css_url
entries.note: No CSS URL: load your stylesheet in the page. Widget parts use tcw- classes and --tcw-* tokens.

entries.name: custom_font_family
entries.note: Give { family } for the chart's text. The widget's own type follows ui.

entries.name: custom_formatters
entries.note: Price formatters go to priceFormat (a function), time and date formatters to timeFormatter. The signatures differ: rewrite the functions.

entries.name: custom_translate_function
entries.note: Give the strings by key (EN_MESSAGES lists them) instead of a function.

entries.name: numeric_formatting
entries.note: Pick a locale tag (de-DE) whose decimal and grouping marks match; the marks cannot be set one by one.

entries.name: overrides
entries.note: Keys differ: map each with the override table. Colours and widths carry over.

entries.name: settings_overrides
entries.note: No option. Set the Chart Settings in onReady with setSettings(); persistSettings keeps what users change.

entries.name: loading_screen
entries.note: No loading screen options. Style the container background if needed.

entries.name: context_menu
entries.note: These add your entries at the end of menus. Built-in entries are hidden with menu.* feature switches, not by a function.

entries.name: time_scale
entries.note: min_bar_spacing maps to minBarUnit (px per bar slot, default 0.25); rightMargin sets the empty slots at the end.

entries.name: header_widget_buttons_mode
entries.note: No compact or full mode: the toolbar folds its buttons itself when narrow. ui presets change sizes.

entries.name: enabled_features
entries.note: Map each name with the featureset table. Switches are on by default, so most enabled_features need nothing.

entries.name: disabled_features
entries.note: Map each name with the featureset table and set its switch to false.

entries.name: study_count_limit
entries.note: No limit on indicators. Enforce one in your own code if you need it.

entries.name: studies_access
entries.note: A whitelist of indicator ids. A black list must be turned into the allowed ids; names differ, see the study table.

entries.name: studies_overrides
entries.note: Sets an indicator's default style by id; default inputs go in addIndicator's params. Keys differ: see the study table.

entries.name: custom_indicators_getter
entries.note: Register each one as an IndicatorPlugin. The custom study constructors must be rewritten.

entries.name: drawings_access
entries.note: A whitelist of drawing types. A black list must be turned into the allowed types; names differ, see the drawing table.

entries.name: symbol_search_request_delay
entries.note: No delay option. searchSymbols gets an AbortSignal for stale queries; debounce inside it if you need to.

entries.name: symbol_search_complete
entries.note: No hook. Resolve the picked symbol in your feed (resolveSymbol).

entries.name: compare_symbols
entries.note: No preset list in the compare dialog; it searches symbols. Add compares in code with addCompareSymbol().

entries.name: charts_storage_url
entries.note: No REST storage. Give layouts: { storage } with a LayoutStorage (list, load, save, remove) that calls your server.

entries.name: charts_storage_api_version
entries.note: No REST storage, so no version. Drop it.

entries.name: client_id
entries.note: Send it from your own LayoutStorage in layouts: { storage }.

entries.name: user_id
entries.note: Send it from your own LayoutStorage in layouts: { storage }.

entries.name: save_load_adapter
entries.note: Give layouts: { storage }, a LayoutStorage with list, load, save and remove. Saved layouts from the Charting Library cannot be read.

entries.name: load_last_chart
entries.note: Set layouts: { openLast: true }.

entries.name: auto_save_delay
entries.note: Set layouts: { debounceMs } in ms (seconds times 1000). Auto-save is on by default.

entries.name: saved_data
entries.note: The Charting Library layout JSON cannot be read. Save layouts again in TradeCanvas (captureLayout) and give them back with restoreLayout().

entries.name: saved_data_meta_info
entries.note: No equivalent. A saved layout keeps its own name and time.

entries.name: settings_adapter
entries.note: persistSettings keeps settings in localStorage. For a server, save getSettings() on onSettingsChange and give them back with setSettings().

entries.name: custom_chart_description_function
entries.note: Screen-reader text is built in. Its labels can be translated in a11y.labels but not replaced by a function.

entries.name: custom_js_urls
entries.note: No script URLs: import your code in your app.

entries.name: custom_timezones
entries.note: timeZone takes any IANA zone or a fixed offset in minutes; there is no list of extra zones to give.

entries.name: image_storage_adapter
entries.note: No image storage. Take the image with screenshotBlob() and store it yourself.

entries.name: nonce
entries.note: No iframe or injected scripts. The widget injects a <style> element, so a strict CSP must allow it.

entries.name: volume_profile
entries.note: Volume profile is built in; turn it on with chart.setVolumeProfileVisible(true). Options differ: buckets, widthRatio, opacity, highlightPoC.

entries.name: workers
entries.note: No equivalent. Related: chartOptions.indicatorWorker moves indicator maths off the main thread.

entries.name: preset
entries.note: Not in the current interface (older versions had 'mobile'). The widget fits phone widths itself; drop it.

entries.name: broker_config
entries.note: No broker flags. Trading UI is on with trading (default true); orders and positions come from your execution adapter.

entries.name: brokerConfig
entries.note: Deprecated name of broker_config. No broker flags; trading UI is on with trading (default true).

entries.name: broker_factory
entries.note: Write an ExecutionAdapter instead of a broker class; see the broker table.

entries.name: debug_broker
entries.note: No broker logging switch. Drop it.

entries.name: restConfig
entries.note: No REST broker. Write an ExecutionAdapter that calls your API.

entries.name: widgetbar
entries.note: The dock holds a watchlist (watchlist: true), symbol info, data window, object tree and alerts. There is no details or news widget of its own.

entries.name: rss_news_feed
entries.note: No RSS reader: fetch and parse the feed yourself and return NewsItem[] from news(symbol, limit).

entries.name: rss_news_title
entries.note: No title setting for news. Drop it.

entries.name: news_provider
entries.note: Return NewsItem[] newest first. Headlines show in the symbol info panel, and on the chart with newsMarks.

entries.name: trading_customization
entries.note: No equivalent override for order and position lines.
